_notes: Sandbox proxy blocks every retail/CDN host I'd normally pull product images from (TCGplayer, Steel City, DA Card World, Topps, Panini America, Pokemon Center, Wikimedia, Amazon CDN, eBay CDN, even placeholder hosts like loremflickr/picsum). All HEAD probes to those hosts returned proxy 403 'blocked-by-allowlist'. Only raw.githubusercontent.com served real image bytes through the proxy. Pokemon TCG items were covered using the 1niceroli/ptcg-assets repo on GitHub (which has display, ETB, and booster-bundle photos for every modern set). Sports card boxes (NFL/NBA/MLB/Soccer/UFC), accessories, MTG, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, signed memorabilia, and beverages could not be mapped to a verified-working URL from the sandbox -- those items should fall through to the Python script's loremflickr placeholder. Recommendation: re-run this sourcing step from an unrestricted environment, or pre-stage product images in a GitHub repo (raw.githubusercontent.com works) keyed by Clover product ID.
